reviews.text: Thanks for the 5-star review!

Everything was truly incredible! Communication with them from China was a success; everything went perfectly when I arrived with my puppy. They took excellent care of her, everything was very quick, and they helped me manage all the pending tasks. 100 stars, not just 5! ✨ Thank you! 🙏🏻 …
Thanks for the 5-star review!
Kennel Club services are excellent as always and I recommend them to anyone.
Thank you for leaving a 5-star rating, Brandon!
Excellent care.

After using one facility for nearly 20 years, I was extremely nervous in boarding my last surviving child from an initial litter of 8.  However, the staff during boarding and deboarding were exceptional and provided me with the comfort I needed to leave the state and the acknowledgement that I made the right choice when I picked him up.  As a Director of Nurses, I wish the engagement, care, and concern I experienced extended to my patients.  Zeus and I thank you for your excellent care.

Hello everyone! Here’s my story.
We are moving to Hawaii, so I had to use Alaska Air Cargo due to the size of my dog. Alaska Air Cargo made a mistake for not loading my dog on my flight! Even though we spent a lot of money, time, scheduling, and stress! So my dog had to stay in LA overnight to catch the next morning flight. Luckily, The Kennel Club has saved the day and helped so much! They picked my dog up, fed, water, and having a place to stretch his legs after being in a crate for hours! In the process, Erik Stewart and Ariana R. has been keeping in touch and sending photos of my dog the whole day and whole night. Those two employees has been very helpful and making me feel relaxed for my animal. Again, their names were (Erik Stewart and Ariana R.) I would trust them with any pet!
They dropped my dog back at Alaska Air Cargo and made his flight and I am so happy and thankful for them! The Kennel Club is a great place and trust worthy for pets! Thank you so much, you guys are the best! 🤙🏽
Here are some photos they kept in touch with me during the process…

My husband and I have been taking every one of our dogs for over 22 years to the Kennel Club. The services they offer are numerous and really cater to all types of dogs. The employees have always been knowledgeable about each of our pets, know their names , and share information and nice stories about their stay when we pick them up. They have special holiday meals and treats and decorate the lobby, which makes it special for us all . Their grooming department is the best in the entire city. Whenever I have questions  and  call the front desk, they are helpful and incredibly friendly and welcoming. Over the many years that we’ve taken our dogs there, whenever we pull up to drop them off, their tails are wagging and they’re so excited to get inside and rush out to fun zone. This is a wonderful company, and we are so happy to be lifelong customers.

This Heaven Sent place id Definitely My Dogs 2nd Home
The Personal love that they give to my dog Vaccine, is absolutely exceptional, and God knows she needs it especially after a human mother passed away a few years ago
There are good people here! My fur baby so happy with them. Love it!

There aren't enough stars to give them a higher rating! The communication with them was truly excellent; they were always attentive to our concerns and requests. Michael and Jasmine, thank you so much for all your support throughout this process. You were very punctual in picking up and returning my dogs.
Thanks for the 5-star review!
This is are go to boarding facility! Our dog gets anxious going to Vets or boarding facilities, but they do an amazing job with her!
I hope you get to experience what you put my dog through !

We’ve been boarding our cat at Kennel Club LAX for years whenever we go on holiday, and it’s been a great experience overall. The location is incredibly convenient, right next to LAX, so we can drop him off on the way to the airport.

The cat condos are spacious, especially if you opt for the double unit. During his stay, the staff regularly send photos, which we really appreciate, it’s reassuring to see how he’s doing while we’re away.

Pricing is definitely on the higher end, particularly during holidays and if you add extras like activities. However, we’ve found it to be worth it. Our cat always seems happy and healthy when we pick him up, which gives us a lot of peace of mind.

A bit pricey but they will take care of your dog during quarantine for your pet coming back from high risk countries. Highly recommend if you and your pet visit a high risk rabies county, that you have these good people look after your pet during the CDC review. Thank you to Jasmine and her crew that looked after Snuggles.

⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️⭐️
LAX Kennel Club is truly amazing. Such caring and compassionate people — they took great care of my dog, Hunny Gurl, when her flight got canceled. Knowing she was safe, comfortable, and loved during an unexpected situation gave me so much peace of mind. I’m incredibly grateful for their kindness and professionalism. Highly recommend!

I think they provide excellent service. My puppy traveled from Colombia to Los Angeles as cargo, and the Kennel company coordinated his entire arrival. They were very attentive to him and kept me informed. They always answered my questions and advised me throughout the process. I especially appreciate Michael's assistance, as he always answered my questions and kept me updated on my puppy's well-being. I also found their service much more affordable than the other CDC in Los Angeles, which charged extra fees for everything. At Kennel, I feel they charge fair prices and have good rates.

I cannot say enough wonderful things about LAX Kennel. From the moment I left my pup, I felt completely at ease knowing he was in such great hands. He was truly well taken care of and closely watched, and I really appreciated receiving pictures and regular updates on his progress—it meant everything to me.

It was his first time here, and the entire staff went above and beyond to make sure he was comfortable, safe, and loved. Every interaction showed genuine care and professionalism. The staff was absolutely exceptional, and I am beyond grateful for the experience they provided for my pup. Highly recommend LAX Kennel to anyone looking for a place they can truly trust.
They take such good care of our cat!
helped with preps and paperwork for CDC process, however facility and kennels not clean my dog got the fleas and we are still unable to get rid of fleas months later !!
Thank you so much for sharing your 5-star rating!

The personal at the desk are rude and they can even could understand my pet's name who was "tobi" and she was repeating "sowy"
Also they had my dog in a empty room with a couple blankets without a dogbed, and when I pick up my dog he had fleas that comes for that place cuz I give it pill and I just let him one night and he was clean.

Kennel Club LAX is awesome!  Like many pet parents, we worry about boarding our furry family members while traveling and we will now worry no more.  Our recent experience here could have ended so badly, but the staff here made all the difference.

We recently started boarding our dog at Kennel Club LAX again after several years of being away (only because we were boarding somewhere else closer to home) and are so grateful for the excellent care our boy received, especially after he suffered a medical emergency while there.  His issue was no fault of Kennel Club LAX and we are so thankful to the staff here for taking quick action to get him emergency veterinary care.  We owe a huge debt of gratitude to Isabella, who acted quickly to get him the emergency care he needed in a timely manner.  She stayed in constant communication with us, which was a huge relief while so far away from home and having to make last minute travel plans to return.

I will absolutely use Kennel Club LAX again in the future.  The facilities and staff here are first rate!
Great ppl and great job! They do care about animals. And I appreciate their professional ethics. Cheers from Shan!

We recently traveled from Bangkok to Los Angeles with our dog, and the process felt overwhelming at first. Michael and Brady at the Kennel Club were outstanding every step of the way — professional, incredibly communicative, and always quick to answer questions. They helped us navigate each stage of this complicated process with calm confidence, which made a stressful experience so much easier. Their care, attention, and clear guidance gave us peace of mind, and we’re so grateful for their support. Highly recommend the Kennel Club if you’re traveling internationally with a pet!
We appreciate the 5-star review, Sidnei!

Staff is nice but there is a strong odor of urine when you go in. My cat seemed at peace but was sneezing when we got home and I had to wash him to get the odor off of him. Prices are OK a bit high compared to other places Iv been.
Kennel club is so good place! Employers are very helpful and warming! Especially Eric, he took good care of my dog and provided a lot of help! They do care about dogs.
Our dogs are always so excited to get out of the car to stay at LAX kennel.  The staff is amazing and they always send pictures of my dogs.  Love this place!!!!

I cannot express the gratitude we have for this company. We had the most bizarre situation happen with our baby blue. And every step of the way this company went out of there way to not only help us figure out a way to bring him home but to also make him feel as comfortable and at home as possible. When he wouldn’t eat they offered him there own rice and chicken, had him seen by there own vet due to his injuries and even completely redid his room to make sure his wounds were treated properly and he wasn’t in pain. Kimberly , Brody and there entire staff were nothing but kind and accommodating. I probably called 6 times a day for an update on blue and every time I called they were kind and sent me pictures. Thank you so much for everything.

I really appreciate the customer service, but there was minimal communication regarding my cat's diarrhea during pick-up. I loved receiving weekly pictures of my cat, Hashy, but the dorms could use some improvements.

Thanks for watching my cat.
Alex is a great guy who really helped my dog and I when we needed a last minute health certificate for travel!

My dog LOVES coming here, she’s so happy at drop off and pick up, they send me the most adorable pictures of her during the day. The staff play w her and I am not anxious or worried about her. It’s the best day care situation we’ve ever had. They also give the best baths!!! Highly recommend!! Thank u! :)
They've been taking great care of my dog for years. You can tell the staff are true dog lovers!

I boarded my dogs (2) at Kennel Club LAX for the 24-hour re-vaccination period after importing them through the airport. The staff were quick to pick the dogs up and responsive to my worries and questions. I got pictures when I requested them and updates about how the dogs did. The staff helped me break down our crates when I picked the dogs up, gave me lots of advice, and were professional and kind. They deal with hundreds of dogs each week, and there were many people checking in dogs  who the staff knew by name. I have nothing negative to say!

Our cat was boarded here for an extended period while waiting for paperwork to go through for her to fly.

The staff is very friendly, clearly animal people. They allowed us to come by the day after dropping off our cat to visit her one last time before we left. We spent 30 mins or so and they didn't rush us or anything. They had a few senior looking dogs hanging out behind the reception desk, I assume they were boarded but I thought it was nice they were allowed to sit and spend time outside their cages with the humans.

During our cats stay Kennel Club staff were always quick to reply to texts and willing to send pictures and videos if we asked. We provided food and a blanket our cat was used to and the staff was willing to put those in her kennel and follow our feeding instructions. They also held onto her crate she was to fly with and allowed a vet to come in and provide requires care for her paperwork.

My one issue is that when we booked online we paid in full in advance, and the site still made it seem like we owed funds. I had to call and double check and the issue was never resolved online. But when we showed up on the day, they did not ask us to pay any more.

Overall great experience, thanks for taking care of our beloved kitty!

I have trusted and relied upon the Kennel Club LAX for years. Their access to LAX allows me to pick up/drop off my dogs on my way to/from my flights 24/7/365. I have also witnessed a staff member rushing a sick dog to an emergency vet late one evening (saving that dog’s life); they genuinely care about and for our pets. I also love their options for my dogs’ stays: from a regular kennel to private rooms with beds, a variety of playtime options and grooming services. They are the ideal place for my dogs when I travel; I never have to worry because I know they are in great hands.
Our dog Magician had a great time and Kennel Club! She came back happy and the staff were very professional and communicative during her entire stay. We will happily bring her back again!

I have been boarding my dogs with Kennel Club LAX for about 20 years.  I have always had a positive experience there and my dogs do well there because of an excellent competent and caring staff.  I always feel comfortable boarding there and I don’t worry about them while they are there.  I strongly recommend Kennel Club LAX!

Thank you guys!
You're the best people on the planet!

I contacted Kennel Club LAX to bring my dog to the US from a high-risk country. Dylan was very helpful, promptly answering my emails and verifying all the documents before my flight. He also provided detailed instructions for when I landed.
Brady picked up my dog on time and sent me updates and pictures, showing that my dog had food, water, and a comfortable spot to stay. Despite my initial worries about leaving my dog overnight, she was happy, not stressed, and very clean when I picked her up in the morning.
The staff was friendly, provided updates about my dog's stay, returned her belongings clean, and gave me a new rabies certificate. They also encouraged me to contact them if I needed any further assistance.
I was concerned about the process and the overnight stay, but Kennel Club LAX made it a great experience. I couldn't be more satisfied with their service.
Puneet, thank you for the 5-star review!

The staff is very friendly. They took care of my dog ​​from the moment I arrived at the airport in the United States, and it was excellent service. They are professionals at what they do and took good care of him.
We appreciate that 5-star rating, Ronald!
Thank you for sharing your 5-star experience!
Amazing staff and great service
Still a great place for pets when they are away from home.
Nothing but praise for Kennel Club LAX, Never need to worry when boarding Kona there when we travel to Europe for a few weeks each year, knowing that she is getting the best care and attention.
